status: PRE-EXECUTION SPEC: committed before the run
goal: S-13: each class (E, PV, SST, VIP) fires in the 1000 ms run; none silent

drive.name: external DC input current
drive.units: JaxFNE Izhikevich native current units (uncalibrated; docs/theory/notes/NEURON_IO_CHARACTERIZATION.md). No pA mapping is applied.
drive.applied_to: every neuron (declared reading; the owner's value named no cell class)
drive.realization: emitter drive_per_neuron = tonic drive + 1.0, via with_emitter_parameters; no schedule, so the drive additivity guard (jomission/harness/drive.py) does not apply
drive.read_back: receipt drive_mean_by_class holds tonic and effective per class

search.note: The owner fixed DC at 1.0; no search parameter is declared, so a single run is the whole lineage. Any new parameter needs a new spec and a log-spaced grid.

criterion.pass: for each class, mean rate > 0 and silent_neurons == 0

stop_condition: a class silent: STOP and report; no retune after results; owner decides any new lineage
reported_not_gated: class rates against the bands PV 12-25 Hz, VIP 8-15 Hz, SST 6-12 Hz (plan decision 3)
